description: Open the EPFL BellaLui 2020 rocket design at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/EPFL_BellaLui_2020.ork in OpenRocket. Navigate to the Flight Simulations tab. Create a new simulation, then run it. After the simulation completes, open the simulation results plot window to view the altitude vs time graph. Export the simulation data to a CSV file at /home/ga/Documents/exports/bellalui_simulation.csv using the Export button in the plot/data dialog.
